messages.content:
Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
Within what time limit must the ministerial decree amending the list of equipment in Annex VII, provided for by Article 71(14) of Legislative Decree 81/2008, be adopted?

response.text: By what deadline is the ministerial decree that revises the list of equipment in Annex VII, as envisioned by Article 71(14) of Legislative Decree 81/2008, required to be adopted?
